description: state.json:4 still reports `"currentPhase": "2c"`, and `phaseHistory` (state.json:5-31) has no entry at all for an implementation-review phase, despite: (a) a full iteration-1 impl-review having already run and produced a FAIL verdict with 7 findings (reviews/impl/iteration-1/output/verdict.json), and (b) behavioral-spec.md's own Changelog section (lines 222-250, 'impl iter1 fixes FIND-001..007') documenting that all 7 findings were subsequently fixed at the code level. The feature's own tracked build-state record therefore does not reflect its actual, already-more-advanced progress -- per this project's own VCSDD process rule (CLAUDE.md: 'SPEC本文への手書き追記だけで進捗を語り、コマンドを呼ばない/state.jsonが進まないのは Verify をやったことにならない'), state.json failing to advance past 2c despite a completed review-and-fix cycle is itself a process-integrity gap, not merely a paperwork nit -- it means anyone consulting state.json alone (rather than reading the reviews/ tree and the spec Changelog by hand, as this review had to) would incorrectly believe no implementation review has ever occurred on this feature.
